region_order: Destination: Skellige - unlocks region (Following the Thread can be started earlier in Novigrad at L11 but must pause before the Seven Cats Inn talk)
The King is Dead - Long Live the King - unlocks Possession, Lord of Undvik, Cave of Dreams, Phantom of Eldberg
Contract: The Phantom of Eldberg then Stranger in a Strange Land - must begin before King's Gambit
The Cave of Dreams (+ An Unpaid Debt) - locked once King's Gambit starts
Echoes of the Past, Missing Persons, Nameless, The Calm Before the Storm - main chain
The Last Wish - immediately, before Uma
Flesh for Sale - before the Seven Cats Inn scene of Following the Thread
Following the Thread (Seven Cats, Faroe/Hammond, Nowhere Inn, Karadin) + Gwent Lambert - before Uma
Possession and The Lord of Undvik - any order, after Cave/Stranger
King's Gambit then Coronation - before the Isle
Gwent: Skellige Style - Lugos before Battle Preparations, Crach before On Thin Ice
Ugly Baby (collect Uma) then Disturbance, To Bait a Forktail, Final Trial, No Place Like Home, Va Fail Elaine
Berengar's Blade (talk to Vesemir first), Triss' earring, Lambert gwent - before sailing
Brothers In Arms Velen/Novigrad/Skellige/Nilfgaard - before the Isle; ask Zoltan only after A Dangerous Game
Dijkstra gwent before Final Preparations; Thaler before Reason of State
Named save, then The Isle of Mists
Battle of Kaer Morhen, Blood on the Battlefield (snowball, Velen), Bald Mountain
Final Preparations (Ciri meets Lodge alone; Blindingly Obvious bribe), Reason of State
Battle Preparations (wreck lab, Skjall's Grave); Reason of State and Contract: Devil by the Well done before telling Avallac'h; On Thin Ice

quests.title: Destination: Skellige
quests.start: Starts automatically at end of Imperial Audience (Novigrad harbour; pay Captain Wolverstone 1000 crowns at the Golden Sturgeon).
quests.mapping_evidence: Pins q201_captain, steingrim, burial, ship battle match captain/Steingrim/Wolverstone voyage.

quests.title: The King is Dead - Long Live the King
quests.start: Follows Destination: Skellige (Kaer Trolde wake).
quests.mapping_evidence: quest_db.json 'pirate.journal' has Q201 Bran's Reception, Feast at Kaer Trolde, Mousesack lab, race, Kill Earth Elemental = wiki objectives (race with Cerys, Ermion's workshop, earth elemental). File is absent from journal_names_*.json, only in quest_db.json.

quests.title: Echoes of the Past
quests.start: After The King is Dead.

needs_before.quest: The King is Dead - Long Live the King

quests.mapping_evidence: Objectives 'Talk to Yennefer at cataclysm', 'Use mask artifact1-4', 'Help Yennefer with monsters' match wiki (mask of Uroboros, magic storm).

quests.title: Missing Persons / Nameless
quests.start: Main Skellige chain after Echoes of the Past.
quests.mapping_evidence: Only generic 'Quest Started/Ended' + Lofoten/herbarium entries; not matched objective by objective.

quests.title: The Calm Before the Storm
quests.start: After Nameless (Skjall in Freya's Garden).
quests.mapping_evidence: 'Ciri - safe heaven','cool off','have a shot' = sauna scene with Astrid/Freya's Firewater.

quests.title: The Last Wish
quests.start: Yennefer asks you to meet her in Larvik at end of The Calm Before the Storm (Skellige).

must_finish_before.event: Ugly Baby: collecting Uma at Crow's Perch
must_finish_before.why: Fails when Uma is retrieved from Crow's Perch (Yennefer and Lambert move to Kaer Morhen). Not doing it also locks the Yennefer romance.

quests.fails_or_locks_when: Retrieving Uma at Crow's Perch during Ugly Baby (wiki cutoff_quest = Ugly Baby). Not the moment Ugly Baby merely appears.
quests.mapping_evidence: Objectives 'Meet Yennfer in Warrior's House in Larvik', 'Get to Larvik's bay', 'Get on boat', 'Sail ... to found Djinn', 'Kill Djinn', 'SQ202 End - In Love / Not So In Love' match wiki walkthrough exactly.
unverified: Exact journal-state moment of Uma pickup.

quests.title: Following the Thread
quests.start: Notice 'Contract: Monster in the Bits' on Hierarch Square board (Novigrad), then the watermill near Arette; finishing needs Skellige unlocked (Faroe).

needs_before.why: FFS is lost once Lambert talks to you at Seven Cats Inn, so do FFS first

must_finish_before.event: Ugly Baby: collecting Uma at Crow's Perch
must_finish_before.why: Fails if not completed before retrieving Uma

quests.fails_or_locks_when: Retrieving Uma at Crow's Perch (Ugly Baby). Journal also has 'Quest Fail before/after meeting Lambert'.
quests.mapping_evidence: Entries 'Quest Start - met lambert', 'Go to Faroe', 'Hammond', 'Ask Crach', 'meet Lambert nowhere', 'Selyse'/'Tauler', 'Vienne junkies' match objectives (Ekimmara, Vienne, Hammond, Crach, Nowhere Inn, Karadin). File is in journal_names_1.json.

quests.title: Flesh for Sale
quests.start: Trottheim, Faroe (needs Skellige unlocked).

must_finish_before.event: Following the Thread: first conversation with Lambert at Seven Cats Inn (after watermill)

quests.fails_or_locks_when: After the talk with Lambert at the Seven Cats Inn in Following the Thread (NOT the later Faroe trip).
quests.mapping_evidence: 'Follow the pirate to this boss','Defeat the pirates','Find the key to slave cells','Free the slaves','Lead slaves outside the village' = wiki objectives.

quests.title: Contract: The Phantom of Eldberg
quests.start: Jorund in Arinbjorn tavern / notice board.

needs_before.quest: The King is Dead - Long Live the King
needs_before.why: must be started between it and King's Gambit to enable Stranger in a Strange Land

must_finish_before.why: Window for Stranger in a Strange Land closes

quests.fails_or_locks_when: Never fails itself; starting it after King's Gambit means Stranger/An Unpaid Debt are unobtainable.
quests.mapping_evidence: 'Quest Started - noticeboard/ talking to Jorund after q201', Mikkjal, Expiationer, lighthouse = wiki.

quests.title: Stranger in a Strange Land
quests.start: Automatically after the Phantom of Eldberg payment at Arinbjorn inn (brawl, jail at Kaer Muire).

needs_before.why: contract must be started between The King is Dead and King's Gambit

quests.mapping_evidence: 'SQ209 Tavern Brawl','Defeat villagers','Clear your situation with Lugos the Mad','Get out of jail' = wiki.

quests.title: The Cave of Dreams
quests.start: Madman Lugos sends you after Stranger in a Strange Land, or walk up to Blueboy Lugos's ship SE of Holmstein's Port.

needs_before.quest: The King is Dead - Long Live the King

needs_before.why: only for the Madman Lugos route and for An Unpaid Debt; NOT required to start the cave

must_finish_before.why: Quest page: fails if not completed before finishing King's Gambit; King's Gambit page: locked once started. Treat start as the cutoff.

quests.fails_or_locks_when: King's Gambit (NOT Battle Preparations as route.py says).
quests.mapping_evidence: 'Join Lugos the Glaucous expedition to the Cave of Dreams','Explore the cave of dreams to face your fears','Leave the Cave of Dreams','Start Lugos Jr'/'Start from Lugos Mad' = wiki.

quests.title: An Unpaid Debt
quests.start: Simun outside New Port Inn some days after Cave of Dreams (only if you accepted Simun's help in Stranger).
quests.mapping_evidence: mq2051unfinishedbusiness is titled 'MQ2051 Unfinished Business' in the game files: 'Meet with Simun at the lake house', 'Kill Simun's enemy', 'Kill Simun', endings EndProWarrior / EndProSimun. That matches the wiki story (Simun asks you to settle his debt at the lake house). The in-game title differs from the wiki name.
unverified: journal file matched by its objectives, not by an exact title

needs_before.quest: The King is Dead - Long Live the King

must_finish_before.why: needs Possession + Lord of Undvik both done

must_finish_before.event: Battle Preparations (infobox) / Isle of Mists (cutoff list)

quests.mapping_evidence: Entries 'Ask Udalryk where is Cerys','Find Eirik','Kill drowners','Find Broksvard','Find Akis bones in sea','Look for Cerys in abandoned house','Talk to Bergthora' = wiki walkthrough. route.py wrongly uses q206berserkers.

quests.title: The Lord of Undvik
quests.start: Crach an Craite (New Port / Kaer Trolde) after The King is Dead.

needs_before.quest: The King is Dead - Long Live the King

quests.fails_or_locks_when: Wiki infobox: Battle Preparations; Isle of Mists list also names it. Do before the Isle.
quests.mapping_evidence: giant.journal entries 'Q202 Ice_Giant - Begining/Ending/Met Hjalmar/Met Folan', Vigi/Folan mappins, 'Q202 Failed' = wiki (Hjalmar, Folan, Vigi, ice giant). Listed in journal_names_2.json.

quests.title: King's Gambit
quests.start: Starts automatically after BOTH Possession and The Lord of Undvik are completed (Kaer Trolde feast).

needs_before.why: must be finished first or it is locked out
must be finished first or it is locked out

quests.fails_or_locks_when: Fails if not completed before The Isle of Mists. Starting it locks Cave of Dreams and Stranger in a Strange Land. Vildkaarl fistfights must all be done before talking to Crach.
quests.mapping_evidence: q206berserkers entries 'Follow Arnvald to the party','Defeat the Islander','Kill the Berserkers','Q206 Investigation With Cerys / with Hjalmar','Arnvald Died/Lived','Q206 Fail - ...' = King's Gambit walkthrough. route.py maps this file to Possession/Lord of Undvik (wrong).
unverified: Whether quest starts at completion of the second prerequisite or when entering Kaer Trolde.

quests.title: Coronation
quests.start: Immediately after King's Gambit when you helped Cerys or Hjalmar (not if neither).
quests.fails_or_locks_when: Infobox: Battle Preparations; Isle list names it. Do before Isle. Never appears if King's Gambit left both to investigate alone.
quests.mapping_evidence: 'Q208 Cerys the Queen','Q208 Hjamlar the King','To coronation','q208_coronation','Q208 Fail'.

quests.fails_or_locks_when: Lugos: set sail at start of Battle Preparations; Crach: start of the On Thin Ice battle.
